scenario: first-use setup with a project, confirmed through the test-build stand-in, then relaunched
what_it_is: Development evidence about a test build on a hosted runner: the first-use page with a typed project path and new settings, desktop setup's confirmation answered by the test build's stand-in (once to leave setup unchanged, once to create), and a relaunch. The App's native confirmation is not exercised by this scenario. It satisfies nothing in release criteria 1 and 2.
starting_state: A test build; a new throwaway home made for this run; an empty project folder made by the runner inside it; no App data; no credential.
acts: views, clicks, one typed path per first-use launch, and desktop setup's confirmation answered by the stand-in; no file chooser, no sign-in, no model turn
confirms: Create settings and save for next launch…

sheet.title: Desktop setup — next launch only
buttons: Create settings and save for next launch
statement: with an empty config.toml, an empty AGENTS.md and a skills folder. Codex adds its own system skills there, and its own working files to the account directory, when it starts.
Link its config.toml, AGENTS.md and skills to those new settings.
Read, import or change no other Codex settings, home or credential.
Save a private pending request in {app_data}/desktop-startup/request.json.
Codex: the copy included with this App (bundled-owner-use-development).
The current workspace, homes, account/model choices, records and prepared messages stay unchanged. No automatic quit/restart/login/conversation.
